target.title: fix(cli): bound approvals file read size in exec-approvals-cli
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `--file` path in the approvals `set` command reads the target JSON file with an unbounded `await fs.readFile()`, so a user that accidentally passes a very large file (e.g., a multi-GB log instead of an approvals JSON) would cause Node to buffer the whole payload, allocating OOM memory. The `--stdin` path already has a 1 MB bound via `readStdin()` (`EXEC_APPROVALS_STDIN_MAX_BYTES`), but the `--file` path was missing the equivalent guard.

This is a defense-in-depth fix and a sibling-consistency cleanup: in practice approvals JSON files are small (`{ version, agents: { ... } }`), but the file read should be bounded the way the already-merged stdin path is.

## Changes

- Add `readFileWithBound(filePath, maxBytes)` in `exec-approvals-cli.ts`, matching the pattern of the existing `readStdin()`. Uses `await fs.stat()` to check file size before `readFile()`, with the same 1 MB default cap (`EXEC_APPROVALS_STDIN_MAX_BYTES`).
- Replace the `--file` read on the approvals `set` action handler with `readFileWithBound()`.
- Export `readFileWithBound` via the existing `testing` object for focused unit testing.
- Add a focused regression test in `exec-approvals-cli.test.ts` using a temp file at the boundary size to verify the cap, mirroring the existing `bounds approvals JSON read from stdin` test.
- Preserve all existing behavior: small valid files continue to parse through the same `JSON5.parse` and `saveSnapshotTargeted` path.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed**: An oversized `--file` approvals JSON must be rejected before read with an `Exec approvals file exceeds ... bytes` error. A normal-sized (valid) approvals file must continue to parse as before.
- **Real environment tested**: Local Vitest run on Node v22.22.0, exercising the real `fs.stat` + `fs.readFile` against a real temp file on an ext4 filesystem.
- **Exact steps**: `pnpm test src/cli/exec-approvals-cli.test.ts` — 13 tests pass including the new oversized-file regression for both the happy (small file within bound) and unhappy (file 1 byte over bound) paths.
- **Observed result**: All 13 tests pass. The new test creates a temp directory with a small file (resolves to expected content) and a large file (rejects with `Exec approvals file exceeds 100 bytes`). The existing 12 tests pass unmodified.
- **What was not tested**: The full `openclaw approvals set --file path` end-to-end command integration; the unit-level `readFileWithBound` helper owns the file read bound and is the correct coverage boundary, matching how `readStdin` is tested.

## Evidence

Focused Vitest:

```
$ pnpm test src/cli/exec-approvals-cli.test.ts

 RUN  v4.1.8

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
```

Format (oxfmt):

```
$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/cli/exec-approvals-cli.ts src/cli/exec-approvals-cli.test.ts
  (clean)
```

**Label**: security

_AI-assisted._
